name: Etched Note
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 40 experience instead of 50, 0.8 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, adventurer. I believe she was sent by the hunter trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
narrative.objectives: Read the Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Red Cloud Mesa.
narrative.offerRewardText: And it is my job to make sure you are prepared by teaching you the basics of our profession--how to tame your pet, how to fire your rifle, and many other skills that will become necessary.Hunters are a strong part of our tradition and history, adventurer. You would do well to remember how important you are to the tribe. You will be respected and revered if you serve our people well.
narrative.requestItemsText: Welcome to Camp Narache, adventurer. I hear good things about you. Your bloodline is strong, and many of the elders consider you skilled already. But that we will test.The plains of Mulgore will be your home for sometime--you should do your best to learn it very well. One day you will travel to unfamilar lands to master greater skills. You must be ready.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 1 to 2, 210 XP in all.

quests.name: The Hunt Begins
quests.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
